articles.title: Chelsea sign Brighton striker Danny Welbeck
articles.snippet: LONDON - Chelsea signed Brighton’s veteran striker Danny Welbeck in a deal worth a reported £5 million (S$8.6 million) on Aug 1. Welbeck agreed a two-year contract with the Blues and will link up with Xabi Alonso’s squad on their pre-season tour. The 35-year-old’s move to Stamford Bridge is a break from Chelsea’s habit of signing younger players with the potential to be developed into stars or sold at a profit. articles.title: Tata Motors PV Sales Surge 59% To 63,760 Units In July 2026
articles.snippet: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd. reported a strong July 2026, with total sales rising 59 per cent year-on-year to 63,760 units across domestic and international markets. articles.title: Who is Soman Rana? Army boxer who survived a mine blast before becoming India's Commonwealth shot put gold medallist
articles.snippet: Soman Rana’s journey to the top of the Commonwealth podium did not begin inside an athletics circle. It began in a boxing ring, continued through years of service in the Indian Army and appeared to have been brought to an abrupt end by a mine blast that cost him his right leg. Nearly two decades after that life-changing injury, Rana stood as a Commonwealth champion.
